items.title: NBA veteran D'Angelo Russell signs with team in China
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former NBA All-Star guard D'Angelo Russell signed a contract with the Shanghai Sharks of the Chinese Basketball Association.
items.body:
Former NBA All-Star guard D'Angelo Russell signed a contract with the Shanghai Sharks of the Chinese Basketball Association.
The CBA announced the transaction Wednesday on social media.
The Los Angeles Lakers made Russell the No. 2 pick of the 2015 NBA Draft, and he also played for the Brooklyn Nets, Golden State Warriors, Minnesota Timberwolves and Dallas Mavericks over 11 seasons.
The Mavericks traded Russell, 30, to the Wizards on Feb. 5 as part of a three-team trade, but he never played for Washington. The Wizards flipped the 6-foot-3 Russell to the Memphis Grizzlies in a six-team trade on July 8, and Memphis waived him last week.
In 26 games (three starts) last season in Dallas, he averaged 10.2 points, 2.3 rebounds and 4.0 assists per game. In 655 career games (539 starts), Russell has averages of 17.0 points, 3.3 rebounds and 5.6 assists.
He was an All-Star in the 2018-19 season with the Nets when he averaged 21.1 points, 3.9 rebounds and 7.0 assists.
--Field Level Media

items.title: European regulators need more powers to police crypto, watchdog says
items.author: Elizabeth Howcroft
items.creator: Elizabeth Howcroft
items.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority said on Wednesday that European regulators should be given more powers to help them enforce crypto rules, and that ESMA should be able to tell crypto companies to freeze crypto assets when they have reasonable grounds to suspect that they are linked to crime.
items.body:
The European Securities and Markets Authority said on Wednesday that European regulators should be given more powers to help them enforce crypto rules, and that ESMA should be able to tell crypto companies to freeze crypto assets when they have reasonable grounds to suspect that they are linked to crime.
ESMA said national regulators, who are responsible for enforcing the European Union's crypto regulation, called MiCA, could be given powers to remove websites for scams or unauthorised crypto companies.
They and ESMA should be given more power to make crypto companies freeze assets in the case of financial crime, money-laundering or terrorist financing, ESMA said.
"Because of current lengthy procedures, when the freezing of suspicious crypto assets (linked to criminal activities) is requested, it is often too late and the assets have disappeared," it said.
ESMA also proposed that certain misleading crypto marketing techniques should be banned and there should be rules for third-party marketing.
Country-level regulators should be given specific powers to combat crypto companies in non-EU countries which actively solicit EU investors without having authorisation, ESMA said.
It proposed that crypto companies should be required to provide full cost information to customers.
The proposals are part of the watchdog's response to a consultation on MiCA, which is being reviewed. A group of central banks in Europe also published their response [USN:L6N45E0EG TEXT:"last week"].
Some regulators have expressed concern about regulatory divergence and patchy enforcement of the MiCA rules.

items.title: Stars G Casey DeSmith signs 2-year, $5M extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Dallas Stars signed goaltender Casey DeSmith to a two-year, $5 million contract extension.
items.body:
The Dallas Stars signed goaltender Casey DeSmith to a two-year, $5 million contract extension.
The deal announced Wednesday with the 35-year-old veteran covers the 2027-28 and 2028-29 seasons.
"Extending Casey has been a priority for us, and we're excited to have him locked up for two more years," general manager Jim Nill said. "He's been incredibly reliable during his time with our organization, and we are looking forward to the tandem of Casey and Jake (Oettinger) continuing to anchor our team moving forward."
DeSmith was 15-8-6 with one shutout, a .2.43 goals-against average and a .907 save percentage in 30 games with the Stars last season. He is 99-69-29 with 13 shutouts, a 2.74 GAA and a .910 save percentage in 220 career games with the Pittsburgh Penguins (2017-23), Vancouver Canucks (2023-24) and Dallas.
The Stars open the regular season on Friday against the visiting St. Louis Blues.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Panama commission recommends reopening First Quantum mine in order to gradually close it
items.author: Elida Moreno, Divya Rajagopal
items.creator: Elida Moreno, Divya Rajagopal
items.summary: Shares of Canada's First Quantum Minerals tumbled on Wednesday after a government-commissioned study in Panama recommended negotiating a new arrangement that could allow a temporary restart of the Cobre Panama mine to facilitate its orderly closure.
items.body:
Shares of Canada's First Quantum Minerals (FM.TO) tumbled on Wednesday after a government-commissioned study in Panama recommended negotiating a new arrangement that could allow a temporary restart of the Cobre Panama mine to facilitate its orderly closure.
The study marks another development in the long-running dispute over the mine, which was responsible for 1% of copper production worldwide until the government shuttered it in 2023 following protests from local residents over tax contributions and its environmental impact.
Effectively, the commission recommends "establishing the conditions for a restart that enables achieving an orderly closure at no cost to the nation."
It also recommends resolving all arbitration claims filed by First Quantum against the government following the mine's closure.
Shares of First Quantum Minerals plummeted 31% on the Toronto Stock Exchange following the announcement.
Panama's President Jose Raul Mulino said at a press conference on Wednesday that he would carefully analyze the contents of the study before making a firm decision on the future of one of the world's largest open-pit copper deposits.
[USN:L1N45L16L TEXT:"Reuters reported"] earlier on Wednesday that the commission would propose a state partnership with Canada's First Quantum Minerals in order to restart the shuttered mine.

items.title: Italy to seek more leeway on EU budget rules to factor in inflation impact
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy wants European Union authorities to grant "additional flexibility" on the bloc's budget rules to factor in the impact of spiking inflation fueled by energy costs, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said on Wednesday.
items.body:
Italy wants European Union authorities to grant "additional flexibility" on the bloc's budget rules to factor in the impact of spiking inflation fueled by energy costs, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said on Wednesday.
"I will send a letter to [European Commission President Ursula] von der Leyen ," Meloni said at an event organised by newspaper Il Gazzettino.
Meloni added she would spend €14 billion ($16 billion) over two years to lower energy costs for firms by tapping into a so-called "national escape clause" from EU budget rules.
But she said Rome would put pressure on the EU to secure further budget leeway, without giving details.
"Higher inflation must be taken into account when calculating the EU parameters for the permitted deficit," Meloni said.
($1 = 0.8823 euros)

items.title: Fed deve dar uma pausa em outubro após dados de inflação
items.author: Ann Saphir
items.creator: Ann Saphir
items.summary: Um aumento da taxa de juros pelo Federal Reserve no próximo mês parecia menos provável nesta quarta-feira, depois que novos dados do governo mostraram que a inflação subiu menos do que o esperado em agosto, aliviando a pressão sobre o banco central dos Estados Unidos para agir na véspera das eleições nacionais de novembro.
items.body:
Um aumento da taxa de juros pelo Federal Reserve no próximo mês parecia menos provável nesta quarta-feira, depois que novos dados do governo mostraram que a inflação subiu menos do que o esperado em agosto, aliviando a pressão sobre o banco central dos Estados Unidos para agir na véspera das eleições nacionais de novembro.
O índice de preços PCE subiu 3,4% nos 12 meses até agosto, informou o Escritório de Análise Econômica, mesma taxa de julho em dado revisado para baixo.
Economistas esperavam que o aumento em agosto fosse de 3,7%. Analistas observaram que, com a inflação ainda acima da meta de 2% do Fed, é provável que haja outro aumento nos juros ainda este ano.
“A porcentagem dos componentes de preços do PCE que estão subindo a uma taxa superior a 3% ao ano diminuiu um pouco, passando de 54% para 51%, embora esse nível ainda seja muito superior ao normal, o que oferece poucos motivos para acreditar que a tendência subjacente da inflação tenha melhorado significativamente”, escreveu Sal Guatieri, economista sênior do BMO. “Isso reforçará a visão (do Fed) de que é necessário um aperto monetário adicional para conter a inflação e levá-la de volta à meta.”
O Fed receberá outros dados nas semanas que antecedem sua reunião de 27 e 28 de outubro, incluindo o relatório mensal sobre o mercado de trabalho na sexta-feira e os dados sobre a inflação ao consumidor de setembro.
Os republicanos defendem maiorias estreitas no Congresso nas eleições de 3 de novembro, e as pesquisas mostram que o aumento dos preços — impulsionado em parte pela alta da gasolina devido ao conflito no Oriente Médio — está minando o apoio entre os eleitores.

items.title: 米ＧＤＰ確報値、第2四半期は2.2％増に上方修正　堅調な個人消費寄与
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　３０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　３０日　ロイター] - 米商務省が３０日発表した２０２６年第２・四半期（２６年４─６月期）の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）確報値は年率換算で前期比２．２％増と、改定値の１．５％増から上方修正された。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト調査を上回った。個人消費や人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ整備に関連する企業投資が伸びに寄与した。

２６年１─３月期は２．５％と、確報値２．１％から上方修正された。商務省は、２１年まで遡ってＧＤＰの数値を改定した。

米経済活動の３分の２超を占める個人消費は２６年４─６月期に３．８％増と、改定値の３．４％から上方修正された。２６年１─３月期は０．７％増だった。

２６年４─６月期の国内民間最終需要（貿易、在庫、政府支出を除く）は４．６％増。４．２％増から上方修正された。前四半期は１．８％増に改定された。

２６年４─６月期の国内総所得（ＧＤＩ）は２．６％増と、２．２％増から上方修正。経済活動を判断する上でより良い指標とされるＧＤＰとＧＤＩの平均は２．４％増と、１．８％増から修正された。

ガソリン価格の高騰などで家計の負担は重くなる中、貯蓄率を低下させつつ、個人消費の伸びが続いたとみられる。

items.title: More than 270 priests in Massachusetts abused children over decades, probe finds
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: More than 270 Catholic clerics sexually abused nearly 1,000 children across three Massachusetts dioceses over decades, according to an investigative report the state's attorney general released on Wednesday.
items.body:
More than 270 Catholic clerics sexually abused nearly 1,000 children across three Massachusetts dioceses over decades, according to an investigative report the state's attorney general released on Wednesday.
The report provided what Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell called the first full public accounting of the abuse and institutional failures that allowed it to proliferate for more than half a century at the Catholic dioceses of Fall River, Springfield and Worcester.
The investigation found that for years those dioceses knew that children were being abused by priests, but "too often they protected the reputation of the church rather than protecting children," she said.
"Behind every one of those numbers is a child whose safety was violated, a family that was changed forever, and a survivor who carried the trauma of that abuse for years and, in many cases, decades," Campbell told reporters.
The Diocese of Worcester in a statement said it would study the report "to identify any additional improvements that can be made to respond to victims of past abuse and to continue to strengthen efforts to keep children safe." The other two did not respond immediately to requests for comment.
The majority of the abuse occurred before 2002. The clergy sex abuse scandal burst onto the international stage that year when the Boston Globe published its Pulitzer Prize-winning report on how officials at the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Boston routinely covered up sex abuse by priests.
The newspaper's reporting set off a global wave of investigations that found similar patterns at dioceses worldwide and prompted Massachusetts' legislature to pass a series of reforms in 2002.
In 2019, then-Attorney General Maura Healey, now Massachusetts' governor, launched a criminal probe into the Roman Catholic Dioceses of Fall River, Springfield and Worcester to determine if they or their leadership bore responsibility in connection to their supervision of clergy who abused children.
Campbell, who said she herself was a victim of child abuse at the hands of a relative, said her office made three referrals to local district attorneys during the probe, leading to charges in one case in Worcester.
Her office did not pursue any prosecutions due to some conduct not being illegal at the time it occurred or because the statute of limitations had expired, she said.
Campbell said the report demonstrated the need for the dioceses to institute reforms and for new state laws supporting abuse survivors, including eliminating the statute of limitations for civil claims involving childhood sexual abuse.

items.title: Agências elevam teto de captação de água pela Sabesp do Sistema Cantareira
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA) e a Agência de Águas do Estado de São Paulo (SP Águas) anunciaram nesta quarta-feira aumento do limite de uso do sistema de mananciais Cantareira pela Sabesp a partir de outubro.
items.body:
A Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA) e a Agência de Águas do Estado de São Paulo (SP Águas) anunciaram nesta quarta-feira aumento do limite de uso do sistema de mananciais Cantareira pela Sabesp (SBSP3.SA) a partir de outubro.
As agências afirmaram que a elevação do teto de captação de água do Cantareira pela companhia foi de [USN:L1N44S0V6 TEXT:"27"] para 31 metros cúbicos por segundo. O aumento foi decidido depois que as fortes chuvas que atingiram São Paulo este mês elevaram o nível dos reservatórios do sistema de cerca de 33% no final de agosto para 41,10% nesta quarta-feira.
"Como o volume útil está na faixa entre 40% e 60% no último dia útil de setembro, a operação do sistema em outubro passará a ser na Faixa 2 - Atenção", afirmou a ANA em comunicado à imprensa. "Com isso, a Sabesp está autorizada a retirar do Cantareira até 31 metros cúbicos por segundo (m³/s)", previstos na legislação.
O Sistema Cantareira é o maior produtor de água da região metropolitana de São Paulo, responsável pelo abastecimento de cerca de 46% da população. É formado por cinco reservatórios - Jaguari, Jacareí, Cachoeira, Atibainha e Paiva Castro -, conectados por túneis subterrâneos e canais.
O sistema de gestão do Cantareira prevê cinco faixas de captação de água, indo desde a "normal", quando o volume útil está acima de 60% e a retirada máxima é de 33 m³/s, a "especial", quando o nível fica abaixo de 20% e o limite de captação é reduzido para 15,5 m³/s.
O Cantareira começou o ano com nível de 20,1%, segundo dados da Sabesp, e foi crescendo durante o período chuvoso, atingindo o pico no ano até agora de 44,1%, em 25 de março, segundo dados da Sabesp.

items.title: BMW aposta em cortes, novos modelos e IA para recuperar fôlego
items.author: Christina Amann, Rachel More
items.creator: Christina Amann, Rachel More
items.summary: A BMW divulgou nesta quarta-feira um plano de reestruturação centrado em inteligência artificial, cortes de funcionários administrativos e lançamento de dois novos modelos, buscando restaurar a confiança dos investidores após uma série de alertas sobre resultados e forte queda no preço de suas ações.
items.body:
A BMW (BMWG.DE) divulgou nesta quarta-feira um plano de reestruturação centrado em inteligência artificial, cortes de funcionários administrativos e lançamento de dois novos modelos, buscando restaurar a confiança dos investidores após uma série de alertas sobre resultados e forte queda no preço de suas ações.
Enquanto a indústria automotiva europeia enfrenta dificuldades com demanda fraca, concorrência chinesa e tarifas de importação dos EUA, a reputação de estabilidade da BMW sofreu um golpe em junho, quando a empresa divulgou seu terceiro alerta de resultado relacionado ao fraco desempenho na China em pouco mais de três anos.
A empresa respondeu com um programa de demissões que deve afetar cerca de 8.000 funcionários na Alemanha, juntando-se às rivais Volkswagen e Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) na estratégia de redução de custos.
A BMW, cujas ações caíram mais de um terço no último ano, atingindo o nível mais baixo em mais de seis anos, divulgou o plano de recuperação durante um evento de dois dias para investidores.
A empresa estabeleceu uma meta de médio prazo de 3% a 5% para as margens em seu principal negócio automotivo até 2028. No início da década de 2030, a BMW pretende retornar a uma faixa de margem de 8% a 10%, ante os 2,3% registrados em seus últimos resultados.
Até meados de 2027, o grupo pretende reduzir em 20% o número de divisões e cargos de gestão associados. A inteligência artificial terá um papel central nos esforços para otimizar a empresa e acelerar a tomada de decisões, afirmou a companhia.
O presidente-executivo, Milan Nedeljković, afirmou que os planos ajudarão a BMW a “enfrentar a concorrência cada vez mais acirrada que definirá esse setor nos próximos anos”.
“Não se trata de um programa de redução de custos”, disse o ex-chefe de produção, que assumiu o cargo de presidente-executivo em maio.
O grupo também está adaptando sua estratégia de produtos às tendências divergentes nos principais mercados, planejando um veículo elétrico básico para a Europa a partir de 2028, ao mesmo tempo em que visa os consumidores mais abastados dos Estados Unidos com um novo utilitário de luxo.
Na China, a BMW planeja localizar ainda mais a produção e contar mais com parceiros locais para tecnologias como direção autônoma e software integrado. A empresa também está analisando possíveis exportações da China para o Sudeste Asiático.
“Em condições cada vez mais desafiadoras, definimos medidas iniciais para nos reposicionarmos e as implementaremos com grande impulso”, disse Nedeljković, acrescentando que a BMW não poderia ter previsto a rapidez com que o mercado chinês estava mudando e, por isso, se manteve cautelosa em suas previsões.

items.title: TAUX Le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans en passe d'enregistrer sa plus forte hausse trimestrielle depuis 1987
items.author: Alun John
items.creator: Alun John
items.summary: Le rendement des obligations françaises à dix ans devrait enregistrer ce mercredi sa plus forte hausse trimestrielle depuis près de 40 ans et sa plus importante progression mensuelle en près de quatre ans, soulignant l'ampleur de la vague de cession de ces créances observée en septembre à l'échelle mondiale.
items.body:
Le rendement des obligations françaises à dix ans devrait enregistrer ce mercredi sa plus forte hausse trimestrielle depuis près de 40 ans et sa plus importante progression mensuelle en près de quatre ans, soulignant l'ampleur de la vague de cession de ces créances observée en septembre à l'échelle mondiale.
Même si les rendements souverains de la zone euro reculent mercredi après les sommets atteints en début de semaine, le reflux reste limité par les nouveaux chiffres de l'inflation publiés en France, en Allemagne et en Italie.
Les rendements obligataires ont bondi ce mois-ci dans la perspective d'un durcissement monétaire de la part des grandes banques centrales sur fond de flambée des coûts de l'énergie, alimentant les craintes d'une inflation hors de contrôle.
L'essor de l'intelligence artificielle (IA), qui stimule la croissance économique, a également conduit les investisseurs à se préparer à des taux d'intérêt durablement élevés.
A ces facteurs en cours dans le monde, s'ajoute le déficit budgétaire galopant de la France qui pourrait ne pas se résorber dans un avenir prochain alors que l'élection présidentielle, prévue en avril et mai, donne lieu à une surenchère de promesses de dépenses de la part des candidats.
Le rendement de l'OAT française à dix ans frôle désormais les 5% et a touché mercredi en séance 4,8349%, proche du pic de 18 ans atteint mardi. . Il a progressé au total, à ce stade, de 61 points de base (pdb) sur l'ensemble du mois septembre, sa plus forte hausse mensuelle depuis fin 2022. La prime demandée par les investisseurs pour l'OAT à dix ans est ainsi nettement supérieure à celle exigée pour les obligations équivalentes des autres grands pays de la zone euro.
Sur une base plus élargie, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans a progressé de 113 points de base depuis début juillet, ce qui représente sa plus forte hausse trimestrielle depuis 1987.
EMPRUNT DE €340 MILLIARDS EN 2027 Cela commence à peser sur la marge de manœuvre du gouvernement qui doit présenter jeudi un projet de loi de finances avec 54 milliards d'euros d'effort de redressement des comptes.
Pour couvrir un déficit budgétaire très élevé, l'Agence France Trésor a annoncé mardi que la France allait émettre l'an prochain 340 milliards d'euros d'obligations à moyen et long terme, un montant [USN:S8N3YU0E2 TEXT:"record"].
La charge de la dette devrait désormais être supérieure de cinq milliards d'euros en 2026 et de sept milliards d'euros en 2027 par rapport aux montants prévus il y a un an.
"La hausse des taux d'intérêt devient donc une source de détérioration budgétaire, rendant encore plus difficile la stabilisation de la dette publique", a souligné Charlotte de Montpellier, économiste chez ING.
Le "spread", c'est-à-dire l'écart entre les coûts d'emprunt à dix ans de la France et de l'Allemagne, s'affiche désormais à 124 points de base, le niveau le plus élevé depuis 2012.
"Une amélioration de la situation au Moyen-Orient et un recul des prix de l'énergie pourraient faire baisser les taux d'intérêt européens. Mais en l'absence d'une amélioration politique ou budgétaire en France, les chances d'un resserrement significatif de cet écart semblent limitées", a prévenu Charlotte de Montpellier.
Le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans, référence pour la zone euro, reculait mercredi de 4,5 points de base, à 3,56%, s'éloignant de la zone des 3,65% atteinte lundi, son plus haut niveau depuis 2009.
Il a néanmoins, à ce stade, progressé de 26 points de base sur le mois de septembre.
L'INFLATION TEMPÈRE L'OPTIMISME La stabilisation des cours du pétrole, même s'ils restent des niveaux élevés, ainsi que la réticence des banquiers centraux à se plier aux anticipations du marché quant à des hausses rapides et soutenues des taux directeurs, ont contribué récemment à apaiser un peu les opérateurs.
Selon les analystes, certains rééquilibrages de fin de trimestre ont peut-être également joué un rôle.
Aux Etats-Unis, le président de Fed de New York, John Williams, a déclaré mardi que la banque centrale américaine disposait du temps pour évaluer les données économiques avant de procéder à un éventuel relèvement supplémentaire de ses taux directeurs. Cela a incité les traders à revoir à la baisse leurs anticipations d'un renchérissement du coût du crédit en octobre.
En zone euro, Peter Kazimir, membre du Conseil des gouverneurs de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), a déclaré que l'institution de Francfort disposait également d'une marge de manœuvre sur les taux, reprenant ainsi dans les grandes lignes les propos tenus lundi par la présidente de la BCE, Christine Lagarde.
Les rendements européens à court terme, notamment ceux à deux ans, plus sensibles à la politique de la BCE, ont baissé davantage que ceux à dix ans. Le rendement du Bund à deux ans cédait mercredi 6,8 points de base, à 3,20%.
Les données préliminaires sur l'inflation publiées ce mercredi dans plusieurs pays européens, en attendant celles vendredi de l'ensemble du bloc monétaire, ont montré que la pression sur la BCE pourrait continuer à s'accentuer.
[USN:L8N45M116 TEXT:"L'inflation allemande"], calculée selon les normes européennes (IPCH), a ainsi accéléré plus que prévu, à +3,3% sur un an en septembre, tandis qu'en [USN:L8N45M0EM TEXT:"France"] elle est ressortie à 3,4% en rythme annuel, son niveau le plus élevé depuis janvier 2024. En Italie, l'indice des prix à la consommation a grimpé à 41% sur un an.

items.title: ElevenLabs' valuation doubles to $22 billion on surging AI voice-agent demand
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: ElevenLabs said on Wednesday it had completed a $300 million employee tender offer valuing the AI voice generation startup at $22 billion, twice the valuation it secured in its February funding round.
items.body:
ElevenLabs said on Wednesday it had completed a $300 million employee tender offer valuing the AI voice generation startup at $22 billion, twice the valuation it secured in its February funding round.
The tender was led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price, with participation from existing backers such as Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed, and new investors including EQT and Goldman Sachs.
Unlike a conventional fundraising round, a tender offer allows employees and existing shareholders to sell their stocks to investors, providing liquidity without necessarily raising new capital.
Some of the biggest AI investments have gone to developers of AI agents, as businesses increasingly adopt the technology to automate customer service and routine back-office tasks.
The growing adoption has also drawn major technology companies into the market, with Meta Platforms expanding its personal AI agent Muse to [USN:L4N45L0QP TEXT:"small businesses"].
Founded in 2022 by Piotr Dabkowski and CEO Mati Staniszewski, London-based ElevenLabs develops AI voice tools, including technology that converts text into speech.
ElevenLabs said its agents now handle more than 15 million conversations each week, three times the level in February, performing tasks such as processing refunds, renewing insurance policies and booking appointments.
"We're already seeing rapid adoption of expressive voice agents by enterprises and governments, who are deploying them in service of consumers and citizens," co-founder and CEO Mati Staniszewski said.
Its models can speak, listen and translate in more than 90 languages used by over 5.5 billion people, according to the company.
The company was [USN:L4N45L0WY TEXT:"valued"] at $11 billion after raising $500 million in a Series D funding round in February.

items.title: Swiss upper house backs higher hurdle for EU accord ratification
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Switzerland's upper house of parliament on Wednesday voted to make a national referendum on a deal to deepen Swiss economic integration with the European Union dependent on majority support among the country's cantons in addition to voters.
items.body:
Switzerland's upper house of parliament on Wednesday voted to make a national referendum on a deal to deepen Swiss economic integration with the European Union dependent on majority support among the country's cantons in addition to voters.
The lower house must still vote on the matter, but making a referendum contingent on the approval of a majority of its cantons raises the bar to ratification of the accord representing the biggest overhaul of bilateral relations in a generation.
Provided the EU agreement is passed by parliament, a referendum on the deal could be held as soon as next year.

items.title: Nigeria charges man with running fictitious government agency
items.author: Camillus Eboh
items.creator: Camillus Eboh
items.summary: A Nigerian man accused of illegally creating a government agency, installing himself as its boss and securing federal budget allocations for it was charged in court on Wednesday with forgery and impersonation, in a case that has exposed gaps in the checks governing the country's public institutions.
items.body:
A Nigerian man accused of illegally creating a government agency, installing himself as its boss and securing federal budget allocations for it was charged in court on Wednesday with forgery and impersonation, in a case that has exposed gaps in the checks governing the country's public institutions.
Prosecutors allege that Adeniyi Adeyemi had since 2024 posed as director-general of the Presidential Foreign Investment Promotion Council, or PFIPC, an agency the presidency says it neither established nor authorised him to lead.
The purported agency nevertheless obtained office space inside the federal secretariat, secured a roughly $1 million budget allocation this year, and tried to open accounts at the Central Bank of Nigeria, according to court filings. Several government institutions also processed its requests in the belief that it was legitimate.
The case has captivated Nigerians because of the sheer ambition of the alleged enterprise: a state agency that the government says did not exist appears to have negotiated several layers of state bureaucracy.
Dressed in a white kaftan and baseball cap, Adeyemi smiled and chatted with his lawyers before prosecutors read eight charges against him in court in the federal capital Abuja.
He pleaded not guilty to all charges and was sent to prison detention until his next scheduled court appearance on October 12.
For Nigeria, where corruption and weak oversight have long undermined public services and confidence in government, the case is seen reinforcing perceptions that official procedures can be bypassed with the right documents and claims of powerful connections.
Prosecutors have not accused any government officials of conspiring with Adeyemi, who was arrested in southwestern Osun state when a judge issued a warrant for him after he failed to appear in court five times.
Prosecutors accuse Adeyemi of forging an appointment letter purportedly issued by President Bola Tinubu and signed by his chief of staff, Femi Gbajabiamila.
Gbajabiamila could not be reached for comment on Wednesday.
He had told a meeting in Lagos on September 26 that the police, Department of State Services and Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission had cleared him of wrongdoing.
Prosecutors say Adeyemi also used documents bearing presidential letterheads to request office space, staff deployments and cooperation from government agencies.
Adeyemi has denied wrongdoing in interviews with local media, saying that the PFIPC was genuine and that he personally approached budget officials to secure its inclusion in government spending plans.

items.title: Long-unseen works by Van Gogh, Cezanne, Monet estimated at $450 million before auction
items.author: Francesca Halliwell
items.creator: Francesca Halliwell
items.summary: A collection of 12 long-unseen paintings, including works by Vincent van Gogh, Paul Cezanne and Claude Monet, is expected to fetch around $450 million when it goes on sale in New York in November.
items.body:
A collection of 12 long-unseen paintings, including works by Vincent van Gogh, Paul Cezanne and Claude Monet, is expected to fetch around $450 million when it goes on sale in New York in November.
Five of the paintings were unveiled at Sotheby's in London on Wednesday, including Cezanne's "Arlequin" and Monet’s "Le Jardin des Tuileries".
The rest of the collection is currently being showcased digitally, including Van Gogh's "Chataigniers en fleurs", which is estimated to be worth about $180 million. Some of the paintings will travel to galleries worldwide ahead of the New York sale on November 18.
It is "amongst the most valuable collections ever offered at auction," said Helena Newman, Chairman of Sotheby's Europe, adding that the pieces by Cezanne and Van Gogh are expected to achieve record prices.
She said in an interview that Van Gogh’s masterpiece is "an incredibly exciting revelation and discovery," painted at the end of his life in Auvers-sur-Oise, just after he was released from the psychiatric asylum in Saint-Remy-de-Provence.
"It is exploding with positivity and joy and exuberance. Of course, we know from the history of what is to come, that it is just three months before his untimely death," added Newman, who is also Chairman of Impressionist and Modern Art Worldwide.
RECORD PRICES EXPECTED Cezanne's "Arlequin" is one of a rare series of Harlequin paintings created between 1888 and 1890. Unseen in public since 1975, the work is estimated to sell for around $120 million.
"The other three ('Arlequin' versions) are all in museums now, so this is the only example left in private hands," Newman said. The piece "set the scene of artists like Picasso who will continue with the Harlequin subject well into the 20th century," she added.
The auction house expects "Arlequin" to set a new auction record for the artist in November. Cezanne's current record is held by "Les Joueurs de cartes", now in Qatar's national collection, which was reportedly acquired in 2011 for $250 million, then the highest known price paid for a work of art.
Most of the collection's paintings were acquired in London in the 1970s by Carlos Pedro Blaquier and Nelly Blaquier de Arrieta. According to Newman, the collection is not widely known by the public.
"Many of these works have not been seen on exhibition for 50 years or so or more, so its appearance now is a real revelation," she said, adding she expects the collection sale to be historic.
"It will be looked forward to and then looked back to in years to come as one of the legendary collections," Newman said. "One of really the last moments to buy great museum-quality examples by these key artists of Impressionist and Modern art."
($1 = £0.75)

items.title: Tomadores de empréstimos do setor de IA enfrentam mais dificuldade para atraírem investidores
items.author: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.summary: O boom da inteligência artificial chegou aos setores de maior risco dos mercados de crédito dos Estados Unidos, onde bancos cautelosos estão exigindo mais remuneração para financiarem tomadores de empréstimos cujos ganhos futuros ainda não foram comprovados.
items.body:
O boom da inteligência artificial chegou aos setores de maior risco dos mercados de crédito dos Estados Unidos, onde bancos cautelosos estão exigindo mais remuneração para financiarem tomadores de empréstimos cujos ganhos futuros ainda não foram comprovados.
As emissões de dívida relacionadas à IA por empresas com baixa recomendação de crédito totalizaram US$88 bilhões este ano, segundo o Goldman Sachs, com a maior parte dos empréstimos proveniente de emissores norte-americanos. Nos primeiros 11 meses de 2025, as emissões relacionadas à IA no financiamento alavancado, principalmente por meio de títulos de alto risco e empréstimos, somaram apenas US$20 bilhões, afirmaram analistas, citando dados da Neuberger Berman.
Agora, os investidores estão analisando com mais rigor esses tomadores de empréstimo menos consolidados, questionando suas projeções de receita, o valor de suas garantias e quanto de dívida eles podem sustentar de fato. Isso ocorre em um momento em que emissores de dívida no setor de IA com classificações mais altas vêm se lançando em uma onda de endividamento e uma tendência de vendas nos mercados de Treasuries estão elevando os rendimentos de maneira generalizada.
“Quem atua no segmento de alto rendimento gosta de saber quanto fluxo de caixa está por vir, quando esse fluxo de caixa chegará e qual é a probabilidade de que ele não chegue”, disse Larry Holzenthaler, gerente sênior de portfólio de renda fixa da Catalyst Funds. Ele afirmou que as crescentes exigências de remuneração por parte dos investidores refletem o fato de que “esses investidores não participam realmente dos ganhos, pois, se tudo correr bem, você é reembolsado pelo valor nominal, e, se não correr, os credores acabam arcando com as perdas”.
APETITE DE RISCO LIMITADO De modo geral, a propensão ao risco para créditos relacionados à IA permanece moderada, apesar do aumento nas emissões de dívida, afirmaram participantes do mercado. Os compradores de financiamentos alavancados têm se concentrado em tomadores de empréstimos de maior qualidade, dando preferência a empresas com recomendação “BB” ou aquelas logo abaixo do grau de investimento. A demanda continua mais forte para emissores com fluxos de receita previsíveis, respaldados por contratos de longo prazo, ativos tangíveis e bases de clientes consolidadas, disseram gestores de fundos.
Os data centers, muitos dos quais se enquadram nessa categoria de maior qualidade, têm assumido grande parte do fardo em um mercado de alto rendimento que, de outra forma, estaria encolhendo, disse Erin Brown, chefe de financiamento alavancado do BNP Paribas.
Os volumes de alto rendimento estão “basicamente estáveis” em relação ao ano anterior, disse Brown, e “se não fosse pela nova oferta de recursos proveniente dos data centers, teríamos volumes significativamente menores em relação ao ano anterior”.
A oferta de infraestrutura de IA no mercado de alto rendimento atingiu US$40 bilhões neste ano, em comparação com US$12 bilhões em todo o ano de 2025, de acordo com dados do BNP.
No entanto, é improvável que as empresas de IA se posicionem muito abaixo no espectro de crédito devido aos custos de financiamento mais elevados que isso acarreta. Mesmo emissores com recomendação BB+, próxima do grau de investimento, estão pagando rendimentos de aproximadamente 9% a 10%, afirmaram analistas, observando que tomadores de empréstimo com classificações mais baixas poderiam enfrentar custos de financiamento de até 14% a 15%.
Por exemplo, o SoftBank Group (9984.T) , que levantou fundos neste mês e possui recomendação BB+, pagou rendimentos de 8,625% em títulos de 3,5 anos, 9,25% em dívida de 5,5 anos e 9,75% em títulos de 7,5 anos, de acordo com um documento apresentado. Esses são rendimentos normalmente pagos por empresas com classificações significativamente mais baixas, afirmaram os analistas.
DIVERSAS RESTRIÇÕES Os emissores de dívida também estão enfrentando uma base de investidores mais cética no mercado de financiamento alavancado.
Diferentemente dos investidores em títulos com grau de investimento, que podem absorver grandes volumes de dívida de grandes empresas de tecnologia com recomendação elevada, os compradores de títulos de alto rendimento vinculados à IA e de empréstimos alavancados estão mais limitados por fatores como regras de portfólio que restringem sua exposição a tomadores de empréstimo de maior risco, afirmaram analistas.
“Para os investidores em dívida, a proposta é fundamentalmente assimétrica”, escreveu Lotfi Karoui, estrategista de crédito multiativos da PIMCO, em uma nota de pesquisa recente.
“Os retornos são em grande parte contratuais, impulsionados pelo cupom, pelo principal e, no máximo, por alguma compressão do spread”, observou ele, enquanto os riscos variam de altos níveis de endividamento a atrasos nos projetos e mudanças rápidas na tecnologia.
Muitos tomadores de empréstimos do setor de IA também exigem um investimento inicial pesado antes de gerarem fluxo de caixa confiável. Analistas afirmaram que isso torna sua dívida mais difícil de ser absorvida pelos maiores compradores de empréstimos alavancados, gestores de obrigações de empréstimos garantidos (CLOs), especialmente se a alavancagem aumentar, o fluxo de caixa continuar a sair ou as classificações de risco se deteriorarem.
As CLOs normalmente adquirem uma grande carteira desses empréstimos, financiando essas compras por meio da emissão de seus próprios títulos aos investidores.
“De acordo com relatos, os gestores de CLOs estão se tornando mais cautelosos em relação a certas empresas e realmente se certificando de verificar tudo antes de investir”, disse Elizabeth Templeton, gerente sênior de produtos, índices de renda fixa e multiativos, da Morningstar.
O ceticismo do mercado já é evidente. A Zenith Arc, uma empresa de projeto de finalidade específica, vendeu US$2,25 bilhões em títulos de dívida garantidos sênior de cinco anos em agosto para financiar um data center em Oklahoma alugado à Jane Street. Os títulos foram precificados ligeiramente abaixo do valor nominal, a 99,50, com cupom de 8,875%.
Seus títulos caíram inicialmente quase três pontos, para um preço de compra de 96,75, imediatamente após a emissão, segundo analistas. No final de agosto, a Pender Fund Management escreveu em uma carta aos investidores que os títulos da Zenith Arc haviam perdido mais de sete pontos em relação ao preço de emissão.
A Zenith Arc não disponibilizou publicamente seus dados de contato. Um representante da Coatue, a empresa de investimentos por trás da Next Frontier, que é parceira de joint venture no projeto da Zenith Arc, afirmou que a empresa não tinha comentários a fazer.
Para os investidores em títulos de crédito, o episódio ilustra a atenção cada vez maior que os emissores ligados à IA enfrentam, à medida que os empréstimos se deslocam para o extremo inferior do espectro de qualidade. O capital continua disponível para a expansão da IA, mas os investidores estão cada vez mais exigindo provas de que as receitas acabarão por sustentar a dívida que está sendo levantada.
“A piada agora é: ‘Como será a receita no ano que vem? Não sei, mas vai ser enorme’”, disse Holzenthaler, da Catalyst. “Se você é um investidor de crédito, essa é uma resposta realmente ruim vinda de um tomador de empréstimo.”
items.raw_description: O boom da inteligência artificial chegou aos setores de maior risco dos mercados de crédito dos Estados Unidos, onde bancos cautelosos estão exigindo mais remuneração para financiarem tomadores de empréstimos cujos ganhos futuros ainda não foram comprovados.

items.summary: La Federación Suiza de Fútbol (SFV) anunció el miércoles la retirada de su apoyo a la candidatura de Gianni Infantino para un nuevo mandato como presidente de la FIFA.
items.body:
La Federación Suiza de Fútbol (SFV) anunció el miércoles la retirada de su apoyo a la candidatura de Gianni Infantino para un nuevo mandato como presidente de la FIFA.
El comité ejecutivo revocó su apoyo al dirigente futbolístico suizo en una reunión celebrada el 25 de septiembre, tras haber respaldado su candidatura en junio.
"La decisión se produce tras una reevaluación exhaustiva de los acontecimientos de los últimos meses", señaló la SFV en un comunicado.
"Desde el punto de vista de la SFV, diversos incidentes plantean cuestiones fundamentales relativas al liderazgo, la gobernanza, la transparencia y los procesos de toma de decisiones dentro de la FIFA", añadió.

items.title: Why Russia's Kaliningrad is a potential flashpoint with NATO
items.author: Mark Trevelyan
items.creator: Mark Trevelyan
items.summary: Russia has warned NATO that it would be ready to resort to nuclear weapons if the Western alliance tried to cut off or attack the Russian region of Kaliningrad.
items.body:
Russia has [USN:L1N45M0BZ TEXT:"warned"] NATO that it would be ready to resort to nuclear weapons if the Western alliance tried to cut off or attack the Russian region of Kaliningrad.
WHERE AND WHAT IS KALININGRAD? It's a highly militarised exclave - separated from the main mass of Russian territory - that is wedged between NATO members Poland and Lithuania and also borders the Baltic Sea. It has a population of about 1 million and is slightly bigger in area than the US state of Connecticut.
HOW DID IT COME TO BE RUSSIAN? Kaliningrad, formerly the German city of Königsberg and capital of East Prussia, became part of the Soviet Union after the Red Army captured it in April 1945 and the victorious allies divided East Prussia at the end of World War Two.
WHAT MAKES IT STRATEGICALLY IMPORTANT? It provides Russia with a platform for air defence, missile and naval forces that can project power deep into northern and central Europe. At the same time, it is a potentially vulnerable pressure point for Moscow because of its boxed-in location between two NATO states and the difficulty of maintaining supply lines or reinforcing it in the event of a war.
WHAT HAS LED TO THE LATEST SPIKE IN TENSIONS? These have been rising steadily since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine , which led NATO to move decisively to strengthen its eastern flank. The alliance has expanded in the region, with Finland and Sweden joining in 2023 and 2024 respectively.
Russia perceives a growing Western threat to Kaliningrad. In May 2026, it [USN:L8N41X1B1 TEXT:"slammed"] remarks by Lithuania's foreign minister as "verging on insanity" after he said NATO had to show Moscow it was capable of "penetrating the small fortress they've built in Kaliningrad" and razing Russian air defences and missile bases there.
A Western military source told Reuters that dozens of aircraft from NATO members were involved in an unannounced operation in the airspace around Kaliningrad in mid-August, demonstrating the capability to cut off the exclave's radio and radar links as well as its air defences in the event of a conflict with Russia.
In social media posts, Russian embassies in Europe have highlighted what Moscow sees as threatening NATO military movements in the Baltic and hawkish rhetoric on Kaliningrad from policymakers and in the media.
NATO says it has increased its presence in the Baltic Sea partly in response to concerns about threats to critical undersea energy and communications infrastructure. In its response to the Russian warning, it urged Moscow to halt its "increasingly reckless behaviour" and "irresponsible nuclear rhetoric".
WHAT DO EXPERTS FEAR COULD SPARK A CRISIS? European states have been walking a fine line since 2022 - supporting Ukraine with weapons, intelligence and sanctions against Russia while stopping short of joining the conflict themselves - though Moscow said this week they are already [USN:R4N45102Q TEXT:""waging war""] against it.
Security analysts say any miscalculation could lead to a direct military confrontation - and Kaliningrad, by virtue of its location, would be a potential flashpoint.
Among the possible triggers could be drone incidents, disruption of critical infrastructure, major new missile deployments or anything perceived by Moscow as amounting to a NATO attempt to impose a blockade on the exclave.

items.title: US objects to meat processor wage-fixing settlements, citing ‘inadequate’ safeguards
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: President Donald Trump’s administration has urged a US judge to reject approving more than $202 million in proposed worker wage-fixing settlements with major red meat processors, arguing the deals fail to include adequate protections against future violations.
items.body:
President Donald Trump’s administration has urged a US judge to reject approving more than $202 million in proposed worker wage-fixing settlements with major red meat processors, arguing the deals fail to include adequate protections against future violations.
Here are the details:
In a filing on Tuesday in federal court in Colorado, the US Justice Department said pending settlements with companies including Tyson Foods, National Beef and Hormel should include provisions “to ensure that the conduct has halted or prevent the recurrence of such conduct”
A class estimated at tens of thousands of red meat processing workers at 140 plants alleged a years-long conspiracy among JBS, Tyson and other companies to artificially keep wages low. The lawsuit, filed in 2022, said the companies violated antitrust law by sharing confidential compensation data through surveys, meetings and other methods
Tyson and Brazil’s JBS, the world’s largest beef producer, [USN:L2N3FO0AS TEXT:"agreed to pay"] a combined $127.2 million to resolve the claims against them. The meat companies and other defendants have denied wrongdoing
The US is not a party to the lawsuit, but federal law allows it to review proposed settlements and weigh in on whether they serve the public interest. A fairness hearing is scheduled for November 13
“Allegations this serious demand more than monetary relief. In the United States’ view, an appropriate resolution on behalf of these workers should include concrete and enforceable safeguards against future wage fixing,” Justice Department lawyers told the Colorado court
US District Judge Philip Brimmer is not obligated to follow the government’s suggestion to decline final approval of the settlements. The US said it was involved in discussions with the parties in the lawsuit to try to “expediently” resolve its concerns
Lead attorneys for the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment. In court filings, lawyers for the workers have touted the settlements as providing immediate and meaningful benefits
Read more:
[USN:L6N3YA08E TEXT:"Data company Agri Stats settles meat workers’ wage-fixing lawsuit"]
[USN:L1N3KR03G TEXT:"Cargill, Hormel latest to settle US workers' wage-fixing lawsuit"]
[USN:L2N3FO0AS TEXT:"Tyson, JBS to pay $127 million to resolve workers' wage-fixing lawsuit"]
items.raw_description: President Donald Trump’s administration has urged a US judge to reject approving more than $202 million in proposed worker wage-fixing settlements with major red meat processors, arguing the deals fail to include adequate protections against future violations.

items.title: Estoques de milho dos EUA sobem 35% em relação ao ano anterior, diz USDA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Agricultores e empresas de armazenagem de grãos dos EUA tinham 35% mais milho estocado em 1º de setembro do que na mesma data do ano passado, informou o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) na quarta-feira.
items.body:
Agricultores e empresas de armazenagem de grãos dos EUA tinham 35% mais milho estocado em 1º de setembro do que na mesma data do ano passado, informou o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) na quarta-feira.
Operadores avaliaram os estoques depois que o clima quente durante o verão e as chuvas na época da colheita geraram preocupações sobre possíveis danos à safra e incertezas quanto ao volume das colheitas neste ano.
Os estoques de milho atingiram o maior nível em sete anos, totalizando 2,095 bilhões de bushels em 1º de setembro, acima dos 1,551 bilhão registrados um ano antes, segundo relatório trimestral do USDA.
Analistas esperavam 1,918 bilhão, de acordo com uma pesquisa da Reuters.
(Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los agricultores y los operadores del sector de los cereales de Estados Unidos tenían, al 1 de septiembre, un 35% más de maíz almacenado que un año antes, informó el miércoles el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA, por su sigla en inglés).
items.body:
Los agricultores y los operadores del sector de los cereales de Estados Unidos tenían, al 1 de septiembre, un 35% más de maíz almacenado que un año antes, informó el miércoles el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA, por su sigla en inglés).
Los operadores evaluaron las existencias después de que el calor del verano boreal y las lluvias durante la época de cosecha provocaron preocupación por posibles daños a los cultivos e incertidumbre sobre el volumen de las cosechas de otoño.
Las existencias de maíz alcanzaron su nivel más alto en siete años, con 2.095 millones de bushels al 1 de septiembre, frente a los 1.551 millones de hace un año, indicó el USDA en un informe trimestral. Los analistas esperaban 1.918 millones, según una encuesta de Reuters.

items.title: ECB's Lagarde says it 'would not be a good idea' to run for French president
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: European Central Bank chief Christine Lagarde said it would "not be a good idea" to run in France's 2027 presidential race, telling newspaper La Croix on Wednesday that if she were to step down early from the bank in 2027, it would only be by a few months.
items.body:
European Central Bank chief Christine Lagarde said it would "not be a good idea" to run in France's 2027 presidential race, telling newspaper La Croix on Wednesday that if she were to step down early from the bank in 2027, it would only be by a few months.
"That would not be a good idea at all," Lagarde was quoted as saying. "First, there's the question of vitality, energy, and strength. There's also an unavoidable sense of sacrifice in this type of commitment. And I'm 70 years old."
Lagarde's comments appear to end speculation that she might leave the ECB early to seek the top office in France next year.
European Central Bank board member Isabel Schnabel [USN:L1N45G0GU TEXT:"resigned"] last week to take on a senior role at the International Monetary Fund, kicking off a lengthy reshuffle atop Europe's most powerful financial institution.
Lagarde said France currently found itself in a perilous financial situation.
"When your debt is approaching 120% of GDP with no clear trajectory to control its growth, that's a serious issue," she said. "A credible path forward, collective determination, and reforms are needed to restore confidence."
She said France needed to cut down on red tape, deepen labour market reforms and tackle a pensions system that was put under pressure by increasing life expectancy.
She was more upbeat about the solidity of the European financial system.
"We are neither in 2008 nor 2011: the European financial system is much more robust," she said, noting that nations like Greece, Portugal, Ireland, who went "through very painful crises, put their public finances in order ... have since returned to growth that is often above average."

items.title: Legal AI company Clio acquires judge-focused startup to push into courts
items.author: Sara Merken
items.creator: Sara Merken
items.summary: Legal technology company Clio said on Wednesday that it has acquired an AI startup that makes a tool for judges, saying courts need to incorporate AI to keep up with lawyers' use of the technology.
items.body:
Legal technology company Clio said on Wednesday that it has acquired an AI startup that makes a tool for judges, saying courts need to incorporate AI to keep up with lawyers' use of the technology.
Vancouver-based Clio said the acquisition of Learned Hand marks its first direct expansion into the judiciary as part of an ongoing effort. Terms of the deal were not disclosed
“If lawyers and litigants can move dramatically faster while judges and court teams remain constrained by the same capacity, the bottleneck simply shifts to the courts,” Clio CEO and founder Jack Newton said in a statement
Learned Hand’s product connects with courts’ systems to manage cases and helps judges and clerks handle filings, conduct legal research, and draft orders, Clio said
Clio, founded in 2008, streamlines legal work for firms of all sizes and is used to manage cases, research, and workflows
Clio recently hired former Michigan Supreme Court Justice Bridget Mary McCormack and Pablo Arredondo, the co-founder of legal AI company Casetext, to lead its strategy and buildout into the judiciary
Reuters parent company Thomson Reuters acquired Casetext in 2023. Thomson Reuters also sells legal software to courts
Clio [USN:L4N3WM0ZY TEXT:"raised $500 million"] in a funding round led by New Enterprise Associates that valued the company at $5 billion in November 2025

items.title: SNB's Tschudin voices concern about stablecoin impact on central banks
items.author: John Revill
items.creator: John Revill
items.summary: The Swiss National Bank is cautious about the use of digital stable coins, because the technology could make the transmission of monetary policy more difficult, governing board member Petra Tschudin said on Wednesday.
items.body:
The Swiss National Bank is cautious about the use of digital stable coins, because the technology could make the transmission of monetary policy more difficult, governing board member Petra Tschudin said on Wednesday.
"When we introduce innovations, we really need to ask what consequences they have, and how they should be regulated," Tschudin told an event in Zurich.
"If we end up with big stablecoins that are really far removed from the existing two-tier financial system, then that's a situation which increases the burden on central banks in fulfilling their mandate."
A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to hold a steady value by being pegged to a stable asset, like the dollar or gold.
Tschudin said the SNB welcomed innovation, but was concerned about the impact stable coin technology could have on central bank money, the risk-free cash used to settle transactions between commercial banks.
Because stablecoins operate outside the central bank system, a "stablecoin franc" was not automatically guaranteed to be worth the same as a real franc, undermining the principle that money should be uniform everywhere, she said.
There was also a risk if households and businesses shift money they previously held at commercial banks into stablecoins - reducing the amount of money they could lend and affecting interest rates.
This would mean a central bank's policy rate changes have less direct influence by weakening its ability to steer borrowing costs.
"We have an effect on how much credit, or how expensively credit is made available in the economy, and that naturally has knock-on effects for monetary policy," said Tschudin.
"So if we see this effect, we get a certain disruption to the transmission mechanism," she said.

items.title: Sancionada, lei do seguro rural no Brasil traz previsibilidade apesar de vetos, dizem entidades
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O novo marco regulatório do seguro rural do país, sancionado e publicado nesta quarta-feira no Diário Oficial da União, traz mais previsibilidade para o setor agrícola do Brasil, segundo entidades de classe, apesar de alguns vetos à lei aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional.
items.body:
O novo marco regulatório do seguro rural do país, sancionado e publicado nesta quarta-feira no Diário Oficial da União, traz mais previsibilidade para o setor agrícola do Brasil, segundo entidades de classe, apesar de alguns vetos à lei aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional.
A sanção pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva à lei originária em projeto de autoria da senadora Tereza Cristina (PP), ex-ministra da Agricultura no governo de Jair Bolsonaro, cria condições para a regulamentação do Fundo de Catástrofe, que deverá funcionar como um colchão de amortecimento para as seguradoras que estão em regiões críticas, onde há eventos climáticos extremos.
A modernização do marco regulatório acontece após a parcela da área cultivada protegida contra intempéries ter caído de 16,3% em 2021 para 3,3% em 2025, devido à falta de recursos para a subvenção ao prêmio do seguro rural, segundo estudo da Confederação Nacional das Seguradoras (CNseg), da Associação Brasileira do Agronegócio (Abag) e da Associação Nacional das Instituições de Crédito, Financiamento e Investimento (Acrefi).
Neste contexto, a Confederação da Agricultura e Pecuária do Brasil (CNA), o Sistema OCB (Organização das Cooperativas Brasileiras) e a Sociedade Rural Brasileira (SRB) destacaram nesta quarta-feira avanços com a lei que aperfeiçoa o marco legal do seguro rural.
A SRB ressaltou que a nova legislação define prazos para regulação e liquidação de sinistros, reconhece o seguro rural como garantia nas operações de crédito rural e estabelece regras mais claras para o Programa de Subvenção ao Prêmio do Seguro Rural (PSR).
Já o diretor técnico da CNA, Bruno Lucchi, observou que um dos vetos é ao item que tratava de uma alternativa de fontes de recursos para o fundo, por meio das Letras de Risco de Seguro. O outro veto está relacionado à isenção de tributação do seguro.
"Defendíamos essa isenção para ter preços de seguro ao produtor mais baixos. É um ponto que vamos discutir com a FPA (Frente Parlamentar da Agropecuária), sobre a possível derrubada do veto ligado à tributação do seguro", afirmou ele, em nota.
Lucchi acrescentou que o próximo passo é aguardar a regulamentação da lei, que vai depender de decretos, de resoluções do Conselho Monetário Nacional (CMN) e da criação do Estatuto do Fundo.
Essas questões, disse ele, "podem ter avanços em um futuro breve".
O Sistema OCB também avaliou que a Lei 15.526/2026 atende ao principal objetivo defendido pelo setor durante a tramitação, "que é dar previsibilidade ao orçamento do Programa de Subvenção ao Prêmio do Seguro Rural (PSR), além de modernizar e avançar nas estruturas de gestão de riscos rurais".
A entidade destacou em nota que defendia a sanção integral do texto aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional, mas considera que os vetos não alteram esses pontos centrais da lei.
A execução obrigatória do PSR precisa de uma medida de compensação orçamentária, procedimento usual quando uma lei altera a estrutura de despesas da União, explicou a organização.
"O Sistema OCB espera que essa medida e a regulamentação da lei, que envolve decretos, resoluções e o estatuto do Fundo Catástrofe, sejam concluídas nos próximos meses, para que as novas regras alcancem os produtores nas próximas safras", disse.
As entidades defendem que a previsibilidade do seguro rural é condição para perenidade no campo e planejamento para as safras no curto, médio e longo prazos.
Segundo estudo da CNseg, Abag e Acrefi, de um orçamento público para o prêmio do seguro rural inicialmente previsto em R$1,06 bilhão em 2025, aproximadamente R$355 milhões foram cortados e R$90 milhões contingenciados, diante da instabilidade de recursos do governo.
O estudo destacou ainda a importância da expansão do seguro rural no país, considerando perdas econômicas diretas do agronegócio provocadas por eventos climáticos adversos que superaram R$100 bilhões nos últimos três anos.
items.raw_description: O novo marco regulatório do seguro rural do país, sancionado e publicado nesta quarta-feira no Diário Oficial da União, traz mais previsibilidade para o setor agrícola do Brasil, segundo entidades de classe, apesar de alguns vetos à lei aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional.

items.title: Snam, offerte da Retina, Edison e F2i per controllata biometano - fonti

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Il fondo infrastrutturale F2i, Edison e Retina Biometano dovrebbero presentare offerte vincolanti per Bioenerys, la controllata dedicata al biometano di Snam , secondo quanto riferito da tre fonti.
items.body:
Il fondo infrastrutturale F2i, Edison (EDNn.MI) e Retina Biometano dovrebbero presentare offerte vincolanti per Bioenerys, la controllata dedicata al biometano di Snam (SRG.MI) , secondo quanto riferito da tre fonti.
Il termine per la presentazione delle offerte del round finale scade oggi.
La controllata potrebbe essere valutata tra i 400 e i 500 milioni di euro, secondo quanto riferito da due delle fonti.
Nessuna delle parti coinvolte ha rilasciato commenti per il momento.
Bioenerys controlla 40 impianti suddivisi tra 31 strutture della divisione Bioenerys Agri, che producono biometano da rifiuti agricoli e zootecnici, e 9 della divisione Bioenerys Ambiente, che utilizzano rifiuti organici.
Edison presenterà un'offerta solo per Bioenerys Ambiente, mentre F2i è interessata principalmente ad Agri, secondo le fonti. Retina è interessata ad acquisire l’intera attività, hanno aggiunto.
Si stima che Bioenerys produrrà 160 milioni di metri cubi standard di biometano il prossimo anno, ottenendo così una quota del 10% del mercato italiano del biometano, secondo i dati pubblicati dalla stessa Bioenerys.
In qualità di gestore della rete del gas italiana, in base alle regole di mercato, Snam è tenuta a cedere la propria attività nel settore del biometano.
Il biometano viene prodotto mediante trattamento e purificazione del biogas generato dalla decomposizione di materia organica: può essere utilizzato per il riscaldamento, la cottura e le stesse applicazioni del gas da combustibili fossili, ma è considerato rinnovabile e a emissioni zero poiché deriva da materia organica.

items.title: Photo comparison of St Michael’s Mount not evidence rising sea levels are a hoax
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: A two-photograph comparison of the causeway leading to a British tidal island, which was used in online posts to suggest rising sea levels are trivial or a hoax, was likely edited or created with AI.
items.body:
A two-photograph comparison of the causeway leading to a British tidal island, which was used in online posts to suggest rising sea levels are trivial or a hoax, was likely edited or created with AI.
The images — one in black and white and labelled 1906 and the other labelled 2026 – purported to show the tidal causeway between St Michael’s Mount and the Cornish mainland, with the island in the distance and its shoreline appearing little changed.
“Someone save St.Michaels mount quick!” said a September 18 post sharing the images on Facebook, one of which had “Apocalytic Sea Level Rise” written over it. “As can be seen by these dramatic photos, the sea level has been so extreme that if the world doesn’t pay more climate taxes the entire region will be underwater in about 324982271294029 years!”
An analysis using OpenAI’s verification tool determined that the images were likely edited or created using the tech company’s AI models. The tool detects invisible watermarks embedded into the generated media.
The post follows a regular climate-change denial template that obscures current and future impacts of even modest sea level increases, such as increased storm damage and flooding.
The State of the UK Climate in 2025 report says that the UK’s sea level has risen by around 20.1 cm (7.9 inches) since 1901, and about two-thirds of the increase has happened in the last three decades.
This change is far smaller than the predicted daily tidal variations near St Michael’s Mount and would not be visible in photos taken at unknown points in the tidal cycle, a spokesperson for the National Oceanography Centre said.
The sea water level at Penzance (Newlyn), the nearest location to St Michael’s Mount with tidal forecast data, was forecast to reach 5.5 metres (18 feet) at morning high tide on September 30, according to the UK Hydrographic Office, a difference of 4.5 metres (14.8 feet) compared with the afternoon low tide.
The two photographs were published together on Facebook in June 2026, and that post’s caption made a “then and now” comparison without mention of sea level rises. There was no mention that either of the pictures was edited or created using AI.
A spokesperson for St Michael’s Mount highlighted the inaccuracies with the image labelled 2026.
“The image labelled 2026 does not accurately depict St Michael’s Mount,” the spokesperson said by email, adding, “The causeway path and boat positions are wrong, and it shows a permanent sign and more trees than are there today. It should not be presented as a genuine photograph of the Mount in 2026.”
VERDICT Misleading. The two photographs were likely edited or created using AI. The comparison is not evidence that rising sea levels are trivial or a hoax as it does not take into account daily tidal changes at St Michael’s Mount, which are far greater than the extent to which the UK’s sea level has risen.
This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New World Development said on Wednesday its cash crunch had eased further after expanding a loan facility by around HK$1 billion ($127.45 million) and terminating operating rights for a shopping mall next to the Hong Kong airport.
items.body:
New World Development (0017.HK) said on Wednesday its cash crunch had eased further after expanding a loan facility by around HK$1 billion ($127.45 million) and terminating operating rights for a shopping mall next to the Hong Kong airport.
The Hong Kong property developer, the most heavily indebted among its local peers, has been trying to cut debt, dispose of assets and bolster liquidity amid tight credit conditions and a weak property market.
Here are more details:
In a filing, New World said its loan facility with Deutsche Bank was increased to HK$4.9 billion from HK$3.95 billion committed in June
It also said, in a separate filing, that it will surrender the 11 SKIES shopping mall project to the Hong Kong Airport on April 1, 2027, and provide works and services worth up to HK$1.1 billion for free
The company booked a net loss of HK$18.3 billion from the termination, including HK$14.7 billion in impairment losses and HK$2.3 billion in early termination costs
The company logged a net loss of HK$18.3 billion from the termination deed, including impairment losses of HK$14.7 billion and early termination charges of HK$2.3 billion
The termination charges pushed up New World's net loss to HK$28.1 billion for the financial year ended June, from a net loss of HK$16.3 billion in the previous year
Excluding non-cash losses, New World posted core profit of HK$2.2 billion, its first in three years
CEO Echo Huang said the 11 SKIES charges resolved a major issue and that cash flow should improve significantly in the first half of fiscal 2026/27
($1 = 7.8465 Hong Kong dollars)

items.title: US trade chief Greer says new 'Milwaukee Framework' to combat global excess steel capacity
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Wednesday that a new framework for countries to take coordinated action to combat excess steel production capacity will be released at a Group of 20 trade ministers meeting this week.
items.body:
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Wednesday that a new framework for countries to take coordinated action to combat excess steel production capacity will be released at a Group of 20 trade ministers meeting this week.
Greer told reporters after a meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity that the so-called "Milwaukee Framework" will likely encourage countries taking stronger action to raise trade barriers to steel imports from countries with heavy excess capacity, such as China.
"Well, every country will do what they think is appropriate," Greer said when asked whether most G20 countries had agreed to raise tariffs on Chinese steel. "We want to coordinate those measures. The United States has taken robust measures, and it probably makes sense for other countries to do that too."

items.title: Exportaciones de crudo de Pemex caen un 45% en agosto, sube producción de gasolinas y diésel
items.author: Ana Martinez
items.creator: Ana Martinez
items.summary: Las exportaciones de crudo de Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex) se desplomaron un 45% interanual en agosto a 275,737 barriles por día (bpd) y un 39% respecto al mes previo, mientras que la estatal reportó un aumento significativo en la producción de combustibles como diésel y gasolinas y una reducción de las importaciones de dichos petrolíferos.
items.body:
Las exportaciones de crudo de Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex) se desplomaron un 45% interanual en agosto a 275,737 barriles por día (bpd) y un 39% respecto al mes previo, mientras que la estatal reportó un aumento significativo en la producción de combustibles como diésel y gasolinas y una reducción de las importaciones de dichos petrolíferos.
La caída en los envíos al exterior coincide con un repunte en el procesamiento de refinerías locales, aunque la producción de crudo también retrocedió, lo que refleja las dificultades persistentes de Pemex para elevar su bombeo en momentos en que los precios del crudo y los combustibles se han disparado por la guerra en Medio Oriente.
El procesamiento de sus seis refinerías locales se ubicó en 1.208 millones de bpd, un alza del 15% respecto a agosto de 2025 y un 0.7% menos frente a julio de 2026. Solo la refinería Olmeca, la más nueva de Pemex, registró un repunte de procesamiento del 10% en el mes respecto a julio y un 94% interanual en agosto, a 252,471 bpd de su capacidad de 340,000 bpd, según la base de datos de la empresa actualizada la noche del martes.
Pemex incrementó la producción de gasolinas en un 5% en agosto respecto a julio a 439,346 bpd, así como la de diésel en un 9% a 316,279 bpd, y redujo en un 30% la de combustóleo -un combustible residual altamente contaminante-, a 174,416 bpd. En contraste, las importaciones de gasolinas bajaron un 24% en agosto respecto al mes previo, a 291,787 bpd, y las de diésel un 26% a 72,289 bpd.
Reuters reveló a mediados de septiembre que la presidenta mexicana, [USN:L6N45611B TEXT:"Claudia Sheinbaum, increpó a funcionarios de alto nivel "]por la caída en la producción de gasolinas y diésel. Ella sostiene que el país "avanza" hacia la "soberanía energética" que supone recortar drásticamente las exportaciones de crudo y elaborar más combustibles en casa, para bajar las importaciones y suplir la demanda interna.
El Gobierno dijo recientemente en un informe que en el segundo trimestre de 2026 el procesamiento promedio fue menor al del primer trimestre debido principalmente a trabajos de estabilización de la planta reformadora en la refinería Olmeca y por mantenimientos mayores programados en la refinería de Minatitlán. Adicionalmente, los proyectos de aprovechamiento de residuos en Tula y Salina Cruz registraron avances físicos de 97% y 80.1%, respectivamente, al cierre de junio.
La estatal reportó una producción de crudo y condensados de 1.64 millones de bpd en agosto, un 2.2% menos respecto al mes previo y un 0.43% menos interanual, a pesar de haber apostado, una vez más, a una recuperación gradual y seguir contando con el soporte de fondos por parte del Gobierno.
Pemex, que produce el 94% del crudo en el país, solo ha logrado adjudicar 10 de 21 contratos mixtos para la exploración y producción con los que apostó subir el bombeo paulatinamente. Según cifras oficiales, esos contratos consolidados representan un potencial cercano a 39,500 barriles diarios y 102.6 millones de pies cúbicos diarios de gas a diciembre de 2026, con una participación de Pemex del 40%. Al cierre de junio de 2026, siete contratos concluyeron la etapa de transición y se encuentran iniciando la etapa de operación.
Según un plan que presentó la estatal el año pasado, los 21 esquemas para desarrollo mixto podrían aportar en conjunto hasta 450,000 bpd de crudo en su punto máximo, el 25% de la producción nacional esperada para 2033. Sin embargo, las condiciones de los contratos no han atraído a grandes jugadores.

items.title: Desempleo en Colombia aumenta en agosto ante menos contratación estatal
items.author: Nelson Bocanegra
items.creator: Nelson Bocanegra
items.summary: La tasa de desempleo urbano en Colombia aumentó a un 9,1% en agosto, en comparación con el 7,8% en igual mes del año pasado, informó el miércoles el Departamento Nacional de Estadística, una cifra que respalda las expectativas de desaceleración de la economía local.
items.body:
La tasa de desempleo urbano en Colombia aumentó a un 9,1% en agosto, en comparación con el 7,8% en igual mes del año pasado, informó el miércoles el Departamento Nacional de Estadística, una cifra que respalda las expectativas de desaceleración de la economía local.
El desempleo medido en las 13 principales áreas metropolitanas del país en agosto también repuntó con respecto al 8,5% de julio.
Alrededor de dos tercios de los puestos formales de trabajo se concentran en las principales ciudades del país sudamericano de 53 millones de habitantes.
En una medición más amplia pero menos utilizada como referencia por el mercado, el desempleo nacional, que incluye el área rural, saltó a un 9,4% en el octavo mes, superior al 8,6% en el mismo mes de 2025 y al 8,1% de julio último, precisó el DANE en un comunicado.
Al cierre de agosto se contabilizaron 23,7 millones de personas con trabajo, 2,4 millones de desempleados y 15,1 millones de personas fuera de la fuerza laboral, de un total de 41,3 millones en edad de trabajar.
Analistas atribuyeron el incremento del desempleo a la menor contratación en la administración pública, justo en el mes en el que hubo cambio de Gobierno, con la posesión del derechista Abelardo de La Espriella, que prometió reducir el gasto público, incluyendo la contratación estatal de empleados.
Por sectores, la mayor contribución a la creación de puestos de trabajo en agosto se registró en la industria manufacturera, las actividades artísticas y de entretenimiento, el sector agropecuario, las actividades inmobiliarias, así como las financieras y de alojamiento.
En tanto, la proporción de población que trabaja de manera informal a nivel nacional se ubicó en un 54,9% en agosto, superior al 54,5% en julio, aunque inferior al 55,7% en igual mes de 2025, lo que equivale a 13,2 millones de personas, cifra superior a los 10,5 millones de empleados formales.
Los trabajadores informales, aunque reciben un ingreso y están ocupados, carecen de contratos, prestaciones laborales y seguridad social que les garanticen acceso a la salud y al sistema de pensiones.

items.title: FDA seeks scientists and consumer representatives for advisory panels
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration on Wednesday launched a nationwide effort to recruit scientists, medical experts and consumer representatives to its advisory committees, which advise the agency on drugs, vaccines and other regulated products.
items.body:
The US Food and Drug Administration on Wednesday launched a nationwide effort to recruit scientists, medical experts and consumer representatives to its advisory committees, which advise the agency on drugs, vaccines and other regulated products.
Here are few details:
The agency is seeking candidates for current and expected vacancies in areas including oncology, cardiovascular medicine, neurology, genetics and medical devices, it said.
FDA advisory committees, which include physicians, researchers, statisticians, patient advocates and consumer representatives, review scientific evidence and make independent recommendations to the agency. Their recommendations are not binding on the regulator.
"We are actively inviting people from across the country who are on the forefront of their fields," acting FDA Commissioner Kyle Diamantas said.
The FDA will accept nominations on a continuing basis, including self-nominations. It set a November 15 deadline for consumer representatives and November 30 for scientific and other voting members to receive first consideration for current and near-term vacancies. Members may serve terms of up to four years.
The Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to Reuters questions on how many positions are vacant or how the recruitment effort compares with previous drives.

items.author: Andrew Mills

items.summary: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv transmitted emergency signals over Jordanian airspace on Wednesday morning, diverting to Saudi Arabia, initially raising fears of a potential hijacking. The Boeing 737 landed safely at Tabuk airport. What appears to have occurred is a physical altercation between the pilots in the cockpit, with one wielding a knife. Israel’s defence minister said preliminary information suggested an attempt to crash the plane. Passengers reported screaming and blood. It was an extraordinary incident on a route that has become well established since the UAE and Israel normalized ties — and another stark illustration of how raw and unpredictable the region has become.
